summary: Iteration 11 — tested Vendor Favorites, Invitation Respond (accept/decline + reason), and Review Report + Admin Resolve. Backend: 17 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py all pass (17/17). Frontend (Playwright): logged-out heart on portfolio card redirects to /login; logged-in heart on portfolio-fav-user_demo_supplier flips data-favorite attribute; Dashboard tab dash-tab-contractor_buyer-favorit renders favorite-vendors list with fav-vendor-{id}, fav-profile-{id}, fav-invite-{id} (opens invite-dialog) and fav-remove-{id}; vendor-fav-button visible on /vendor/user_demo_supplier; invited supplier on /custom-project/{id} sees vendor-invitation with invitation-accept + invitation-decline -> invitation-decline-reason -> invitation-decline-confirm, then vendor-invitation-done + vendor-invitation-status chip 'Ditolak'; client view shows client-invitations with invitation-status-user_demo_supplier chip 'Ditolak'; vendor reports own review via report-button-{rid} -> report-dialog -> report-reason-spam + report-note-input + report-submit -> report-status-{rid} chip; admin /admin -> admin-tab-reviews -> review-report-board shows report-filter-{pending|hidden|rejected|all}, report-card-{rid} with report-admin-note-{rid} + report-hide-{rid} + report-reject-{rid}; hide action excludes review from GET /api/vendors/{id} and recomputes rating/review_count. Backend endpoints verified: POST /api/favorites/{vendor_id} (self 400, unknown 404, toggle on/off persists), GET /api/favorites (vendor summaries), /api/auth/me includes favorite_vendor_ids; POST /api/custom/projects/{id}/invitation/respond (non-invited 404, duplicate 400, project-must-be-open covered, accept/decline updates invitations + timeline + client notification 'Undangan diterima/ditolak'); GET /api/custom/opportunities shows invited=true + invitation_status + no 'invitations' leak; GET /api/custom/projects/{id} vendor sees only own invitation, client sees all; POST /api/reviews/{id}/report (owner only 403 otherwise, invalid reason 400, duplicate 400); GET /api/admin/review-reports?status={pending|hidden|rejected|all} (admin 403 otherwise); POST /api/admin/review-reports/{id}/resolve (hide hides and recomputes stats, reject keeps, invalid action 400, resolving non-pending 404, vendor notification 'Laporan ulasan disetujui/ditolak').

issues: React hydration warning: <span> is rendered inside <option> (ve dynamic span). Pre-existing from iter10 AdminReviewBoard, not iter11 scope but worth cleaning (option can only contain text). Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py admin_resolve_report sets hidden=False when action=='reject', which also unhides a previously-hidden review if an admin somehow reports+rejects a hidden one. Not reachable via current flow (one report per review, resolving non-pending returns 404), but defensive: only touch 'hidden' when action=='hide'.

reviews.py report_review: `if r.get('report')` blocks any resubmission even after admin rejected a prior report — per spec 'one report per review', which matches, but may frustrate vendors if admin rejects a valid first report and a new issue later arises. Consider allowing resubmission after 'rejected'.

custom_projects.py respond_invitation accepts without any check that user is a verified vendor; non-vendor invited users could technically accept. Mitigated because invite_vendor requires verified vendor to be invited, so this is only reachable if invited user later loses verification — edge case.

custom_projects.py invitations() returns a fresh fallback dict when invitations[v] is missing — ok, but the fallback has 'at': None, which could NPE on date formatters in some clients. Frontend Invitations.jsx doesn't format at, so safe for now.

FavoriteVendors.jsx effect dep on ids (joined string) is reasonable; but ids change recomputes on each render — fine. The `useAuth().user` existence is not guarded (uses `user.favorite_vendor_ids`); if route is reached without auth it would throw. Route is dashboard which is auth-gated so OK.

ReviewReportBoard delete handles report.status missing gracefully via STATUS lookup — but ReviewReport.jsx will crash with 'Cannot destructure undefined' if STATUS has no entry for a status value (e.g. future statuses). Low risk.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (favorites toggle + login redirect + Dashboard favorit tab + vendor profile heart + invitation decline flow + client invitation chip + review report dialog + admin review-report-board hide action)
